summary: Owner requested the Tools maintenance capability and instructed continuation until the backend upgrade is actually available, while previously rejecting temporary Preview Runtime. V2.47.210 is reconciled to a reversible presentation-only management model: workflow definitions and explicit toolbox/workflow placement overrides live only in the existing settings authority and reference canonical Start assets by link_id; toolbox management does not create/update/delete canonical links, categories or tags; canonical URL add/edit/delete remains in the unified resource manager. The stable scene-context contract is aligned with the managed group-definition call. No Schema/Migration/Restore, canonical-data mutation, data-model semantic change, Auth/Security, updater mechanism, provider/server or Production write is included. Existing Tools deep links and automatic inference remain compatible, and deleting/moving presentation blocks is non-destructive.
